name: thumb-index
title: Thumb Index
description: Scroll-spy notches on the page edge, placed where each section sits in the scroll.

props.description: A nav of in-page links. Extends nav props.

props.name: landingOffset
props.description: Px above a section where it counts as reached.

accessibility: A nav of anchors. The current one has aria-current location.
Arrow up and down move between notches.
Notches keep at least 40 px apart.
